notes.title: #02 Devlog-2025/01/14
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Agents:[/h3]

We sincerely apologize for the delay in Demo(α)'s release from October 2024 to January 2025.



#About Demo(α)

The released [b]Demo(α)[/b] is the version we exhibited at the indie game event in 2024, featuring the first half of the game's prologue chapter.

We are currently aware of the following issues:

1.Due to the inclusion of numerous original 3D assets still in development, there are performance drops and stability issues. These will be addressed in [b]Demo(β)[/b], scheduled for release in July 2025.

2.The upcoming [b]Demo(β)[/b] will implement new systems that will appear in the main game.

3.We continue to refine the scenario and text content.



#Development Team and AI Generation Usage

Currently, our development team consists of two members who work on the project in their spare time while maintaining their primary jobs.

To ensure efficient development within our limited time and financial resources, we are experimenting with AI generation for certain assets.

Specifically, we plan to actively utilize AI generation for 2D assets that are either lower priority or particularly suitable for AI-based expression.

[u][b]While we experimented with AI for the English localization in Demo(α), the results weren't satisfactory, so we plan to work with professional localizers for the official release.[/b][/u]



#Future Plans

Starting from 2025, we plan to publish monthly development diaries.

In January, we are focusing on implementing the document system, and we will report on this progress at the end of the month.

We will continue our efforts to deliver an even better product and appreciate your ongoing support.

notes.title: #01 'M.E.M.O' Demo (α) Release Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Agents,[/h1]

We would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who visited our booth at [b]Tokyo Game Show 2024[/b] and experienced our upcoming title, "M.E.M.O" Your enthusiastic participation and invaluable feedback have been an immense source of encouragement for our little team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107597/474389b9266ff2ef7777e57517481d27e740d48b.png[/img]

Throughout the event, we gathered a wide range of opinions and impressions, and our development team directly observed your gameplay experiences. Based on this, we are diligently working on refining and improving the game. 

To allow even more players to experience the allure of "M.E.M.O" [b]we are excited to announce that we will be releasing the demo(α) in mid-October.[/b]

We remain committed to meeting your expectations and are pouring our utmost efforts into development. We sincerely appreciate your continued support and encouragement.
